title: Research library
intro: Explore Toynbee Hall’s community-led research, reports and learning on poverty, inequality and access to support.

blocks.heading: Research shaped by lived experience
paragraphs: Our participatory action research works with people directly affected by policy and services to identify issues, gather evidence and develop recommendations.

blocks.heading: Browse and collaborate
paragraphs: Our work spans income and employment, social and financial inclusion, housing and the environment, health, social care and community. Email research@toynbeehall.org.uk for research enquiries or collaboration.
